## Summary

- Associate Product Manager at TMRW House of Brands (Bewakoof, Nobero, TIGC, Wrogn), part of Aditya Birla Fashion.
- Joined as a Product Management Intern in July 2024; promoted to Associate Product Manager in November 2025.
- Owns homepage, checkout and personalization work for Bewakoof.com (about 200K daily sessions) and builds GenAI content and analytics platforms used across the brands.
- Works directly with multiple brand and merchandising teams: builds the tools they use and improves storefronts based on their requirements and feedback.
- Works across product and engineering: writes PRDs and runs experiments, and also builds and deploys the systems (TypeScript, Python, AWS, GCP).

## Selected work at TMRW

### GoKwik Checkout
- Result: +10.5% lift in session conversion.
- Problem: Checkout is where Bewakoof.com's ~200K daily sessions pay or leave; login and address entry were the slowest steps.
- What Hardik did: owned the checkout roadmap and staged rollout (logged-out users, then all mobile web, then a decoupled login); ran each phase as a GrowthBook experiment with fair funnel definitions; investigated a flat early readout, found an Android payment-completion issue and worked with the vendor on the fix.
- Stack: GrowthBook, BigQuery, SQL, GA4.

### Dynamic Homepage
- Result: +13.8% higher tap rate and +5.4% higher homepage-to-order conversion in a live test.
- Problem: merchandisers ordered homepage content by hand; banner click-through varied from near zero to 20%+ on the same page.
- What Hardik did: led a system that scores every widget and banner from live behaviour and re-ranks six audience-specific homepages; kept merchandisers in control with pins and publish controls; built experiment measurement in from the start; discarded his first scoring model when it failed on fresh data and rebuilt it.
- Stack: Python, BigQuery, scoring service, GrowthBook.

### C&C Platform
- Result: 0-to-1 enterprise GenAI content engine; brand teams go from a creative brief to approved copy and images in one place.
- What Hardik did: led the 0-to-1 build and designed the brief-to-approved-assets workflow; combined brand-context retrieval, multi-model generation (Gemini, Claude, GPT-Image), tiered evaluation and human review; hands-on with AWS deployment, CI/CD, and model cost and usage monitoring.
- Stack: TypeScript, Fastify, Next.js, PostgreSQL/pgvector, BullMQ/Redis, AWS.

### WhyBuy
- Result: AI product imagery and video live on 2,000+ products across six brands.
- What Hardik did: built and launched a platform that generates feature shots, lifestyle images and product videos from catalog data and publishes them to Shopify; partnered with brand teams on the content workflow. It began as a Gemini pipeline he built as an intern.
- Stack: Next.js, FastAPI, Supabase, Gemini, Veo, Cloud Run.

### Helios and Homepage Lens
- Result: wider funnel, metric and tracking coverage, with faster and more accurate reporting for brand teams.
- What Hardik did: built Helios, a multi-brand analytics command center for TIGC and Urbano (funnels, cohorts, experiments, data quality) with an MCP server for plain-English questions; shipped Homepage Lens, which shows reach, CTR and conversion beside each live homepage element.
- Stack: ClickHouse, Cube.js, FastAPI, Next.js, MCP, Metabase.

### Experimentation program
- Result: 30+ A/B tests run end to end across four brand stores, with winners scaled to all users.
- What Hardik did: built and runs the program on GrowthBook, from hypothesis and funnel definition to analysis, leadership readout and rollout decision, across discovery, homepage, checkout and wallet experiences.
- Stack: GrowthBook, BigQuery, SQL, Google Apps Script.
